title: Deadly Train Collision in Egypt Sparks Calls for Safety Reform
subtitle: At least seven people are dead and over 100 injured following a major rail accident in the Giza province.

summary.en: A train collision in Egypt has resulted in at least seven deaths and over 100 injuries. The accident occurred when a moving train hit a stationary train in the Giza province. Emergency teams and local residents worked together to rescue passengers trapped in the wreckage. President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi has ordered an investigation into the cause of the disaster. This event has renewed public concerns regarding the safety and maintenance of Egypt's aging railway system.
summary.zh: 埃及發生一起火車相撞事故，造成至少七人死亡、逾百人受傷。事故起因是一列行駛中的火車撞上停在吉薩省軌道上的另一列火車。緊急救援小組與當地居民合力救出受困於殘骸中的乘客。總統塞西已下令調查災難原因。此事件再次引發公眾對於埃及老舊鐵路系統安全與維護狀況的擔憂。

paragraphs.en: A serious train accident in Egypt has left at least seven people dead and more than 100 injured. The crash occurred on Sunday in the al-Ayyat district of Giza province, located about 50 kilometers south of Cairo. According to the Egyptian railway authority, the incident happened when a train traveling toward Fayoum crashed into the back of another train that was stationary on the tracks. The second train had been heading toward the southern city of Aswan.
paragraphs.zh: 埃及發生一起嚴重的火車事故，造成至少七人死亡，超過一百人受傷。這起撞擊事件發生在週日，地點位於開羅以南約五十公里的吉薩省（Giza）阿亞特區（al-Ayyat）。根據埃及鐵路局指出，當時一列開往法尤姆（Fayoum）的火車，撞上了另一列停在軌道上的火車後方。後者原本正準備前往南部的亞斯文市（Aswan）。

paragraphs.en: The impact was severe, causing several carriages to derail and fall down an embankment. Images from the scene showed overturned train cars, with some appearing to be badly damaged. The driver of one of the trains was among those who lost their lives in the accident. The public prosecutor's office has warned that the death toll could rise as officials continue to assess the damage.
paragraphs.zh: 撞擊力道相當猛烈，導致數節車廂出軌並跌落路堤。現場畫面顯示火車車廂翻覆，部分車廂損毀嚴重。其中一列火車的駕駛也在這起事故中喪生。檢察官辦公室警告，隨著官員持續評估損害情況，死亡人數可能會進一步攀升。

paragraphs.en: Local residents, such as Ayman Gamal from the village of Kafr Girza, were among the first to respond. They rushed to the scene to pull survivors from the wreckage and call for ambulances. Survivors who were taken to the al-Wasta central hospital described scenes of shock and difficulty breathing due to the dust caused by the crash. One passenger, Farha Gamal, told reporters that she saw people struggling to escape the mangled carriages. According to The Guardian, more than 70 of the injured have already been discharged from hospitals after receiving medical care for broken bones and head injuries.
paragraphs.zh: 來自卡夫吉爾扎村（Kafr Girza）的艾曼·賈馬爾（Ayman Gamal）等當地居民是第一批趕到現場的人。他們衝向現場將倖存者從殘骸中拉出，並呼叫救護車。被送往阿瓦斯塔（al-Wasta）中心醫院的倖存者描述了當時震驚的場景，並表示由於撞擊揚起的塵土，導致他們呼吸困難。一名乘客法哈·賈馬爾（Farha Gamal）告訴記者，她看到人們在扭曲變形的車廂中掙扎求生。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，超過七十名傷者在接受骨折與頭部外傷的醫療照護後，已經出院。

paragraphs.en: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi responded to the tragedy by ordering an immediate investigation. In a statement, he promised to hold anyone found to be negligent—meaning someone who failed to do their job properly—accountable for the accident. The government has also placed local hospitals on high alert to ensure they can manage the large number of patients. The Egyptian Red Crescent is currently providing aid and psychological support to the victims and their families.
paragraphs.zh: 埃及總統阿卜杜勒-法塔赫·塞西（Abdel Fattah al-Sisi）對這場悲劇做出回應，下令立即展開調查。他在聲明中承諾，將追究任何被發現有疏失的人員責任，意即那些未能善盡職責的人。政府也已要求當地醫院進入高度戒備狀態，以確保能妥善處理大量病患。埃及紅新月會（Egyptian Red Crescent）目前正為受害者及其家屬提供援助與心理支持。

paragraphs.en: This disaster has occurred in an area known for previous rail tragedies. The crash site is close to where Egypt’s deadliest train accident took place in 2002, when a fire on a passenger train killed more than 370 people. Additionally, there were two other fatal crashes in the same region in 2009. Because of this history, the latest accident has led to public calls for the transport minister to resign, as many citizens question why safety issues persist on this line.
paragraphs.zh: 這場災難發生的區域，過去也曾發生過鐵路悲劇。事故地點鄰近埃及史上最嚴重的火車事故發生地，二〇〇二年時，一列客運火車發生火災，造成超過三百七十人死亡。此外，該地區在二〇〇九年也發生過兩起致命撞擊事故。由於這段歷史，最新的事故引發民眾呼籲交通部長下台，許多公民質疑為何這條路線的安全問題遲遲無法解決。

paragraphs.en: While the Egyptian government has invested billions of dollars into new highways and high-speed rail projects in recent years, the country continues to face challenges with its older railway network. Experts note that the system has a long history of poor maintenance and management. According to Deutsche Welle, authorities are working to clear the wreckage and restore train services, but they have not yet said how long this process will take. Trains between Giza and the Upper Egypt region remain suspended while cranes remove the damaged cars.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管埃及政府近年來投入數十億美元於新建高速公路與高鐵計畫，但該國仍面臨老舊鐵路網的挑戰。專家指出，該系統長期以來維護與管理不善。根據德國之聲（Deutsche Welle）報導，當局正致力於清理殘骸並恢復鐵路服務，但尚未說明需要多少時間。在起重機移除受損車廂期間，吉薩與上埃及地區之間的火車班次仍維持停駛。

paragraphs.en: International leaders have expressed their sympathy following the news. The Saudi Arabian ministry of foreign affairs shared a message of solidarity with Egypt, while the Turkish ambassador to the country offered his condolences to the victims and their families. As the investigation continues, the focus remains on understanding why the stationary train was on the tracks and what steps can be taken to prevent such accidents in the future. For now, the people of Egypt are left to mourn the victims of yet another painful chapter in the country’s railway history.
paragraphs.zh: 國際領袖在得知消息後紛紛表達慰問。沙烏地阿拉伯外交部表達了與埃及團結一致的訊息，土耳其駐埃及大使也向受害者及其家屬致哀。隨著調查持續進行，焦點仍放在釐清為何靜止的火車會停在軌道上，以及未來能採取哪些措施來防止此類事故。目前，埃及人民只能為這段鐵路史上又一痛苦篇章的受害者哀悼。

quiz.question: What is the specific status of the train that was struck by the moving train?

options.A: It was traveling toward Cairo at a high speed.
options.B: It was not moving and was positioned on the tracks.
options.C: It was in the process of derailing due to an embankment.
options.D: It was heading toward the village of Kafr Girza.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，文中明確提到該列車是「stationary on the tracks」（停在軌道上）。選項 A 錯誤，因為該列車並非前往開羅，且處於靜止狀態。選項 C 錯誤，脫軌是撞擊後發生的結果，而非撞擊前的狀態。選項 D 錯誤，文中提到 Kafr Girza 是當地居民的村莊，而非列車的目的地。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the safety of the railway line where the accident occurred?

options.A: It is a newly constructed line that has not yet been tested.
options.B: It has a long-standing reputation for being prone to dangerous incidents.
options.C: It is the only railway line in Egypt that has not received government funding.
options.D: It is currently the safest route for travel between Giza and Aswan.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第五段，該地區在 2002 年發生過嚴重的火災事故，且 2009 年也有兩起致命車禍，這顯示該區域的鐵路系統長期存在安全隱憂。選項 A 與文章描述的「舊鐵路網絡」矛盾。選項 C 無法從文中推論，文中僅提到政府在投資新建設的同時，舊系統仍面臨維護問題。選項 D 與事實完全相反，該區域顯然極度危險。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the word 'negligent' mean in the context of the President's statement?

options.A: Someone who is extremely busy with administrative tasks.
options.B: Someone who performs their duties with excessive caution.
options.C: Someone who fails to fulfill their responsibilities properly.
options.D: Someone who is inexperienced and needs more training.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第四段括號中明確解釋了 'negligent' 的定義為「someone who failed to do their job properly」（未能妥善完成工作的人）。選項 A 與忙碌無關，而是指疏忽。選項 B 是 'cautious' 的定義，與疏忽意思相反。選項 D 雖然可能導致疏忽，但 'negligent' 本身強調的是「未能履行職責」的結果，而非單純指經驗不足。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of the article?

options.A: To profile the heroic actions of local residents during the rescue efforts.
options.B: To compare the efficiency of Egypt's new highways with its old railways.
options.C: To report on a specific train accident and the broader concerns regarding Egypt's railway safety.
options.D: To provide a detailed historical account of every train accident in Egypt since 2002.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文的核心架構是先報導一起具體的火車事故（第一至三段），接著延伸討論政府的回應、公眾對該地區安全紀錄的質疑，以及舊鐵路系統長期維護不善的問題（第四至六段）。選項 A 僅是文章的一小部分細節。選項 B 只是背景資訊，並非文章主旨。選項 D 誇大了文章內容，文中僅提及部分歷史事故作為背景，而非詳盡的歷史紀錄。
